name: mgba-emu/mgba
description: A fast and accurate Game Boy Advance emulator that also supports Game Boy and Game Boy Color titles. Features save states, video recording, Lua scripting, and both Qt and SDL frontends.
score_rationale: The best-in-class GBA emulator with 6.9k stars, MPL-2.0 licensed, actively maintained through 2025 with strong accuracy and feature set.
summary: Best-in-class accurate GBA/Game Boy emulator with debugging tools
